text.en: A cell wall made of chitin is found in Fungi.
Any organism that makes its own food using sunlight belongs to Plantae.

modelCorrection.en: Euglena makes its own food using sunlight, and it is in Protista because it is unicellular.

text.en: Moving from place to place is enough to place an organism in Animalia.

modelCorrection.en: Euglena moves and is not an animal. Cell type, cell structure and food decide the kingdom together.

text.en: No organism in Monera has a membrane-bound nucleus.
